{{Quote|Need baradium charges. Like the ones Brel made. Before he blew up.''"<br />"''Hang on, hang on. Wha&mdash;hey you're hearing that outta context. Brel blew himself up because he got cocky.|[[Anuli]] and [[Gele'ren]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Brel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] explosives maker who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Brel's cockiness eventually led to his [[Death/Legends|death]] when one of his [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] charges blew up, killing him.<ref name="TOR" />
